description: Machine-readable release gate list for Steam Engine Expansion (SEE). mod/build.ps1 evaluates every blocking gate in this file on every run; a blocking gate that was not evaluated, or that failed, aborts the build with a non-zero exit code. See mod/docs/RELEASE_GATES.md for the human-readable table and the requirements mapping.

gates.name: 0 warnings in all four shipping assemblies
gates.evidence: dotnet build <project> -c Release -m:1 -> '0 Warning(s)' (TreatWarningsAsErrors=true in Directory.Build.props)

gates.name: offline test runner passes PASS n/n
gates.evidence: dotnet run --project tests/SEE.Tests -> 'PASS 510/510', exit code 0

gates.name: blueprint generator --check reproduces every generated file
gates.evidence: 'CHECK PASS (0 differences, 83 files, 24 blueprints)'

gates.name: generator's five data gates pass
gates.evidence: 'gates : 5/5 PASS' (water tank autonomy >= 8x fuel autonomy (200 >= 8x25 hours), dedicated water tank: no Water in ConsumedGoods and table tank size, efficiency criterion, fuel capacity equals the table cell by cell, no BuildingPipeSpec/PowerLineSpec/WorkplaceSpec)

gates.name: data validator prints VALIDATION PASSED for every gate group
gates.evidence: 'VALIDATION PASSED', 13/13 gate groups passed, exit code 0

gates.name: manifest.json contract (7 fields, Id, empty mod lists, version 0.1.0)
gates.evidence: PASS  manifest.json

gates.name: engines.json is the single 12-row number source
gates.evidence: PASS  engines.json (12 rows)

gates.name: blueprint documents resolve against the game and SEE spec metadata
gates.evidence: PASS  blueprint spec schema (all 27 documents)

gates.name: 24 blueprints x 12 authoritative fields match engines.json + engines.derived.json with zero error
gates.evidence: PASS  blueprint table (24 x 12 authoritative fields); '24/24 files x 12/12 fields, 0 mismatch(es)'

gates.name: fuel capacity and dedicated water tank derive exactly to the tabulated values
gates.evidence: PASS  fuel/water capacity derivation (float32 ceil(GoodPerHour x 25) fuel; SEE.SEEBoilerSpec.WaterCapacityGoods = waterTankGoods for the code-created dedicated water inventory; no StockpileSpec and no Water ConsumedGood allowed)

gates.name: boiler blueprint rules (no GoodPoweredGeneratorSpec / BuildingPipeSpec / PowerLineSpec / WorkplaceSpec, PowerOutput = Horsepower, Log+Plank fuel whitelist, no Up/Top transput)
gates.evidence: PASS  boiler blueprint rules (AD-9 / AD-5)

gates.name: localization: enUS, zhTW and zhCN each carry exactly the 64 canonical keys (54-key requirements baseline + 9 P4B additions + 1 bottom-bar tool-group label; AC-16 requires >= 54), no raw key, no simplified characters, no vanilla key overwrite
gates.evidence: PASS  localization (64 keys >= 54, enUS/zhTW/zhCN)

gates.name: SEE_Config.json schema 1, all documented groups, every default inside its clamp range
gates.evidence: PASS  config schema and clamp

gates.name: golden hash: the 24 shipped blueprints are byte-identical to tests/SEE.Tests/Golden/blueprints.sha256 (validator and build.ps1 re-hash independently)
gates.evidence: PASS  golden hash (24 blueprints); '24/24 golden entries verified'

gates.name: forbidden static scan: no per-frame Update work/FindObjects, no unsafe/P-Invoke/process/network/thread, no Harmony outside Integration, no hard-coded balance table, no SteamEngine/SteamPlant template or loc names
gates.evidence: PASS  forbidden static scan; '0 red-line hit(s)'

gates.name: shipping-assembly whitelist and layering: exactly SEE.Core/Gameplay/Integration/UI, no SEE.Tests, no external mod DLL, no NuGet, no Harmony reference, Core game-independent, frozen specs intact
gates.evidence: PASS  assembly whitelist and layering

gates.name: source facts: no fork leftovers, no compile-time external-mod reference, no NuGet PackageReference, file/line limits
gates.evidence: PASS  source facts

gates.name: staged package contains exactly the four shipping assemblies; no .deps.json, .pdb, SEE.Tests.dll, src/, tools/ or tests/
gates.evidence: staged file inventory: 4 SEE.*.dll, zero other .dll/.deps.json/.pdb/.exe, no src/tools/tests path

gates.name: staged package carries 24 generated blueprints (12 size/tier x 2 factions) and the two TemplateCollection appends
gates.evidence: staged inventory: Buildings/**/*.blueprint.json = 24, TemplateCollections = 2

gates.name: staged localizations: enUS.csv, zhTW.csv and zhCN.csv each contain the same key count, at least 54 (currently 64)
gates.evidence: staged key count: 64 rows (+header) per language file, both languages equal and >= 54

gates.name: staged icons: 24 PNG sprites plus 24 .png.meta.json with isSprite=true
gates.evidence: staged inventory: Icons/*.png = 24, Icons/*.png.meta.json = 24, every meta parses to isSprite=true

gates.name: version tracks are consistent (manifest 0.1.0 / save schema 1 / config schema 1) and the package hash file is written
gates.evidence: manifest.json Version=0.1.0, SEEVersion.cs 0.1.0/1/1, staged SEE_Config.json configSchemaVersion=1, build/SteamEngineExpansion.sha256 written
